scope: Complete live official job snapshot + preserved local improvements/observations; CPU-only rendering
methodology: Union preserved API captures by job ID to survive latest50 pagination; newest observed row wins. Mode=run determines leaderboard submissions; checks remain separate including failures/noarchive.
Stable job/candidate/improvement/observation IDs; every input/source/raw/review link carries SHA256 when locally present.
Source compiled/available features are distinct from actual per-job selected policies and timed profiles.
No independent-job score subtraction is reported as a causal feature delta.
Feature findings and repeated positive preparation observations are separate tables; no positive threshold removes small observations.
Keep invalid attempts and superseded parents immutable; repairs get new source or attempt identity.
Review provenance gaps explicitly; server content_hash algorithm unknown and not raw SHA256 attestation.
